verdict.rationale: First-party docs say you can export the code and the database and deploy them wherever you like. A project is a real TypeScript/React app you can read or export in full, and a full SQL dump of the Postgres database can be downloaded at any time on any plan. Together these cover open-format export and leaving the platform. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that export and self-hosting work end to end, and evidence that other platform data (visitor analytics, email logs, brokered OAuth/auth setup) can also be exported.
